Both senses stand.", "room": "The phrase \"A verse that carries two senses at once is not open\" weighed as requiring the dual-sense verse to stand rather than be marked UNDERDETERMINED, against reading the separate answers as leaving the verse open.", "why": "Because K-S2 says a verse carrying two senses at once is not open and both senses stand, the judge's use of the two answered senses to label Isaiah 7:14 UNDERDETERMINED breaches the rule."}
